batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b HV Patel

batting.name: SS Iyer
batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: SO Hetmyer
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c K Rabada b A Nortje

batting.name: D Padikkal

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c SS Iyer b AR Patel

balls.text: finds deep midwicket! Kohli takes it a little late to his left though after he ran in a bit too much to his right. Siraj bowls a full-toss on middle, as Hetmyer looks to slog that, but gets that off the higher side of the bat
good, clever bowling! Bowls short of a length and on off, as the ball climbs on to Hetmyer, who misses his pull. First bouncer called
yorker length again, but this is on off. Drilled to deep point
yorker again on middle, but swung away to long-on's right! The helicopter shot comes into play, as Siraj bowls with a scrambled seam with Ripal getting his front leg out of the way before crashing it
fires that back, and Siraj ducks last moment! Full on off, and in the slot on off. Hetmyer rams that back to long-on as Siraj has to duck for life. Just a single taken there
lands that yorker bang on middle and off! Hetmyer tries to jam at that, and ends up getting it off the toe end of the bat and back to the bowler
and again! This is much fuller in length, and outside off too. All Ripal is thinking about is sending that out of the ground, but is beaten by the lack of pace
swing and a miss! Another change of pace ball, but this if on a good length on middle. The ball just goes over the stumps after Ripal misses his slog to the on side
Ripal thinks about making room at first, but then backs away as Harshal bowls very full and outside leg. Another wide
slower ball, and pretty full and wide of off. He has a swing at that away from his body, but the ball is pretty wide
dances down this time to this wide-ish full-toss outside off, and pushes that to long-off. But he is annoyed with himself on not getting that way, and lets out a roar
tonks over long-on! Right in the slot outside off, and Hetmyer ending up across off allows his the room to swing that with the full stretch of the arms
slower ball on a very full length and wide of off. Ballooned to long-on. Hint of that helicopter shot there too
nails that yorker on middle, as Ripal gets an inside edge on to his left boot while trying to drill that out

high full-toss on middle, and pushed through with the angle to deep point! The man on the fence runs to his right and gets a finger, but the ball trickles off to the rope. Hetmyer was playing after making room, but it is not called an above-waist no-ball even if that was played around his chest height
back of a length on off, and angling in. Dabbed to short third man to get off the mark

holes out to long-on! Looks to loft that full-toss outside off, as Siraj bowls with a scrambled seam. Iyer is across off again to try and lift that, but gets that off the bottom of the bat to find the long-on fielder, who doesn't have to move a step
very full and pretty wide of off, as he follows Iyer who goes across off. Tries to jam at that, but doesn't get a bat
yorker length ball outside leg, as he clears his front foot and tries to hoick that away. But the ball trickles off his pads to the off side for a leg-bye
scrambled seam and a full-toss outside off. Driven to the man at deep point
punches that full ball outside off aerially to deep point, who runs and slides to his left to stop that late from crossing the fence
has a flash, but misses! Slower ball and fullish in length, and a touch wide of off. He heaves without foot movement, and is beaten
drills that very full ball outside off to long-on after standing across off again
another very full ball, but this pitches outside leg after he bowls from wide of the crease. Wide called, as Iyer tries to flick from off stump
slower delivery and very full on middle. Iyer flicks this to fine leg after waiting for it to come, as the fielder chases that to his left
Hetmyer lobs that high and on the bounce to long-off, who takes that running to his left. It was a low full-toss outside off, as Hetmyer stepped across to play at that
again Iyer walks across, and clips this lowish full-toss on off to deep square leg
steps across to slam this full ball outside off with the closed face of the bat. Garton tries to get a hand to his right, but ball races to long-on
dabs gently at this fullish ball just outside off to the fielder at short third man. He takes off for a single, but is sent back
good length ball on middle, and clipped to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
short delivery on off, and climbing on to the batter. He fends at that toward square leg with his bottom hand off
another full delivery outside off, and leans into a drive to deep point
starts with a change of pace ball on a full length just outside off, as Iyer pushes it to the right of cover
drives at that full and wide ball outside off after reaching out for it, but finds the man at cover
much fuller in length, and outside leg. A slower ball too, and clipped to fine leg pretty late
Maxwell at long-on runs and dives to his right, but can't cut that off! Shortish in length and wide of off, as Iyer pulls perfectly between deep midwicket and long-on for another four in the over
good length ball on middle and leg, and clipped to deep square leg for a single
rammed over the bowler's head! This is again in the slot on outside off, and he clears his front leg to fetch that scrambled seam ball for six. Excellent follow-through too
drilled between the non-striker and mid-off! He closes the bat face to this length ball outside off, and hammers a blow with the closed face of the bat
full on middle stump, clipped to deep midwicket
slow wrong'un pitching well outside leg. Looks to sweep it fine but he doesn't make clean contact. Hits his body and bounces towards the keeper
wrong'un, slow, turning from just outside leg. Stretches out and blocks it back to the bowler
tossed up on middle stump, driven to long-off

and he's nearly run-out! Flat one slanting across him, and he goes back, defends, and gets an outside edge that dribbles towards short third. Iyer wants the single, Hetmyer is late to respond, and he would have been out by a distance if Siraj had hit the stumps at the bowler's end. Even his dive wouldn't have saved him
back of a length, straightening towards middle stump, goes back and works to deep midwicket
offcutter, moving away from off stump, stays back and dabs to backward point
another bouncy back-of-a-length ball angling across the left hander. Not enough room to steer to third man, and he's beaten on the outside edge

extra bounce, and that gets Christian a big wicket. Back of a length, slanting across Pant, and he makes room to try and slap it away through point, but the ball rises and grabs his top edge through to the keeper

length ball on off stump, and that's superb wristwork to whip it into the big gap between deep backward square leg and deep midwicket. The former makes a good sliding save to his right, and pushes the ball towards the latter
steps out, looks to make room, and ends up making too much room as Christian fires a length ball across him and well outside off. Reaches out to carve it away, but can't connect
length ball on off stump, clipped towards deep midwicket
back of a length, wrong'un, spinning away from off stump, punched to the left of sweeper cover
looped up on middle stump. Looks to drive to mid-off, but the ball doesn't turn as much as he expects, and it rolls down the pitch, hits the stumps at the other end, and ricochets towards long-on
tossed up full on leg stump, driven firmly back towards the bowler, getting his feet out of the way
back of a length, angling across to off stump, makes room and carves to deep point

got him, Shaw falls two short of his fifty. A bit of loop here, brave bowling from Chahal, and Shaw was looking to hit over extra-cover. But the ball dips on him a little, and then turns, and he ends up slicing it squarer than intended, to the man at sweeper cover, who takes the ball on the third attempt while falling forward. It slipped out of his hands, but it hit his thighs rather than fall to the floor, and he managed to hold on thereafter. George Garton the fielder
tossed up on middle and leg, and Chahal lands it right in Shaw's arc. Gets his front leg out of the way, and sinks down low to slog-sweep with great power over midwicket
back of a length on off stump, lets it come on and uses the angle to work it to long leg
length ball close to off stump, gets forward for a push to sweeper cover, who's well in front of square
quickish length ball close to off stump, punched to short extra-cover
lovely shot to start his innings. Harshal goes for the slower ball, overpitches on an off-stumpish line, and he drives smoothly to bisect short extra-cover and mid-off
length ball angling into leg stump, stays on the back foot and clips to fine leg

slower ball, and that's the first wicket for RCB. Looks to make a bit of room, and Harshal follows him with his angle from around the wicket. Lots of revs on this offcutter, but it doesn't actually turn, just beats Dhawan for lack of pace. Looks to hit down the ground, and ends up spooning it high to mid-off
wrong'un, pitching outside leg and turning towards the stumps, goes deep in his crease to tuck it towards short fine leg
flat, angling into middle and leg, pulled to deep square leg

glorious. Sees Shaw step out and fires a quicker one at his pads, looking to deny him room to free his arms. He doesn't need that room. Just uses his wrists for an inside-out golf drive back over the bowler's head
tossed up, angling away from Dhawan and pitching outside off. Makes some room and chips it to the right of long-off
a bit slower on middle and leg, swept to the right of deep square leg
steps out and Chahal bowls a flatter, quicker stump-to-stump ball. Looks to whip it away, and gets an inside edge that rolls towards backward square leg
shortish outside off, chopped down to deep third

juuust clears the rope. Steps across his stumps as Harshal angles a length ball in towards off stump, and he whips it away in the air. Deep square leg throws himself over the rope to try and slap the ball back into play, but he can't quite manage it
fullish, angling into off stump, clipped to deep square leg
back of a length, angling into leg stump, tucked to the right of midwicket
ooh, steep bounce. Looks to step out and make room to slap through the covers, and the extra bounce carries the ball over his top edge
sees him step out and cramps him with a shortish one angling into the body. Looks to work it away, ends up inside-edging into his thigh pad
tossed up wide of off stump, and he lands it a touch fuller than he'd like. Shaw loves it, frees his arms and drives sweetly over extra-cover
short, straightens towards off stump, pulled to deep square leg
down the track, makes plenty of room, flat-bats a stump-to-stump ball down to long-on
down the track and Chahal bowls a flat one at his pads. Tucks it away into the backward square leg region
tossed up on off stump, clears his front leg and slog-sweeps, doesn't really get hold of it and it lands to the right of long-on
flat on middle and leg, goes back and nudges into the midwicket region
back of a length on the pads, tucked away into the square leg region. Not sure if he got bat on it or if it was just off the thigh pad
makes room and Siraj fires in an off-stump yorker. Opens his bat face and slices it to third man
hard length, finishing on top of off stump. Blocked back to the bowler
wow. Pace and steep bounce from just short of a length, on an off-stumpish line. Has to defend in a hurry, and the ball lifts and smacks him on his gloves
back of a length, finishes over middle stump, lets it come and tucks it to deep square leg
back of a length, extra bounce close to off stump. Looks to work it with the initial angle, and gets a leading edge down to third man
full, angling into the pads, and Dhawan puts it away. Poor ball, with fine leg inside the circle, and he whips it away to beat the diving fielder to his left
shortish slower ball, sneaks under the attempted pull and rolls into the leg side off the pad. Pitched well outside leg, so no appeal
shot. Full, angling across to off stump, and Shaw uses the angle expertly to drive on the up between extra-cover and mid-off. Barely moved, just stand-and-deliver stuff
steps out and Garton pulls his length back, angling the ball into Dhawan's body. Whips it away towards deep backward square leg
back of a length close to off stump, punched towards cover point
length ball angling into the stumps, stays back and clips towards mid-on, slightly cramped for room
terrific batting. Expects the shorter ball, having stepped out previously, and gets it, and jumps deep in his crease to punch against the turn between backward point and cover point
shot! Length ball, offers a hint of width, and Shaw steps out and pounces on it, driving with high left elbow to beat extra-cover to his right
tossed up slow wide of off stump, looks to drive through point, ends up chopping it to short third instead

first six of the match. Flat length ball, sliding on into the stumps. Not the worst ball, but Dhawan premeditates and picks the right ball for it, uses the inward angle to sweep in the air over the backward square leg boundary
drops short, but the ball grips and turns to cramp Shaw a little while pulling. Hit in the air, but on the bounce, to deep square leg
quickish length ball on off stump, clipped to midwicket off the front foot
back of a length close to off stump, waits on the back foot and stabs towards backward point
length ball on middle and leg, clipped away to the right of deep square leg
back of a length on off stump, lets it come on and dabs gently towards point
short on leg stump, pulled to deep square leg
short now, angling into the body, pulled on the first bounce to deep square leg

high full-toss, and it's immediately no-balled. Dhawan jumps out of his crease, and he's startled as this one slips out of Garton's hand. Looks to whip it away, and the ball lobs off his left shoulder and is caught by backward point diving forward
Back of a length on leg stump, tucked to the left of short fine leg
turns into the pads now, clipped to deep square leg
flat, looks to cramp Shaw for room but ends up spinning it down the leg side, left alone
back of a length on off stump, worked to deep midwicket off the back foot
just short of a length, spinning in towards leg stump, opens up to pull to deep square leg
stays back to a flat length ball on middle stump, punches to midwicket
flatter, angling into middle and leg, worked away off the back foot through backward square leg
tossed up on off stump, straightens from a good length, gets forward and dabs gently towards short third
bouncer now, over Dhawan's right shoulder, tucking him up for room. Swivels and manages to place his hook to the left of deep square leg
Drifts a touch too straight, and Dhawan whips it away off his pads, to the right of the man at deep square leg. He doesn't have too much distance to cover, but it's travelling too quickly to stop
oooh, lovely. Length ball, pitching on middle and leg or thereabouts and nipping away like an offcutter. Dhawan's feet are stuck, looks to push into the covers and he's beaten on the outside edge
back of a length, angling across to off stump, waits on the back foot and dabs to short third
length ball, swinging away in the corridor, and now deep point has gone back to the rope. Gets forward to drive on the up to that fielder
super shot. Good-length ball outside off, and Shaw presses forward and extends his arms through a straight-bat punch between backward point and cover point
length ball on off stump, stays back to clip to the left of midwicket
back of a length close to off stump, dabs with soft hands towards cover point and picks up a quick single
shot! Tossed up, and he offers a bit of width. Dhawan gets a nice stride forward and drives in the air, between extra-cover and mid-off
shortish, spinning in towards leg stump, opens up at the hip to swipe to deep square leg
back of a length, straightening towards off stump, goes deep in his crease to whip to deep square leg
length ball fired into the pads, clipped to deep square leg
drifts down leg to start, past the attempted flick

glory shot! Srikar Bharat has done the semi-impossible. Full toss on middle. Bharat goes right into his crease, and then smacks it over the bowler's head. Long on is getting under it, but then sees it soar over his head! Royal Challengers Bangalore win by seven wickets after Avesh bowls a terrible last ball
full toss down the leg side. Bharat misses any connection, and they get one free run
yorker, just outside off. Bharat digs it away to midwicket, and they come back for two after Axar misfields
top ball. Full and wide, but inside the tramlines. Bharat looks for a straight loft over Avesh but makes zero contact

yorker length, around leg stump. Maxwell clears the front leg to access the on-side but the ball goes under the bat. Hits the boot, but its definitely going down leg. Pant reviews the lbw shout even though this is not out
good length outside off stump. Picks the lack of pace early, and pulled along the ground to deep midwicket for two. Another fifty for Maxi
full outside off. Clears the front leg, goes low, and then hits a flat-batted swat over mid off for four!
full toss, wide outside off. Opportunity for Bharat to club a cut through the off side but misses. Top over from Nortje!
quick ball, back of a length outside off. Maxwell walks across to the offside to pull, but mistimed. Ball rolls away to square leg
yorker length outside off. Dug away to cover. Only one, bringing Maxwell back on strike
good length outside off. Angling into Maxi, and swiped along the ground to deep midwicket
good length outside off stump. and dug away to midwicket's left
full on off stump. Slaps a drive to cover, but intercepted
top edged over the keeper! Back of a length on off. Backs away to cut over point. Streaky shot for four
good length outside off. Swipes it to midwicket's right for a single
full on off stump. Goes deep in his crease and tries to slog a six over long on. In the air, but falls short of the man in the deep
yorker attempted. Ends up as an overpitched delivery. Driven to long off for a single past the bowler
full on off. Looks to nudge a shot to cover. Inside edged past the stumps to fine leg for a double
full on off stump. Tucks it square to deep backward square leg for a single
full outside off, and driven to long on for a single
good length outside off, and pushed to cover for a quick single
good length, on off stump. Goes deep in his crease and picks the cutter early. Pulled in front of square to deep midwicket for six!
full and wide outside off. Looks to play the cover drive but it is sliced over point.
slower ball. Full and wide. Mistimed shot to cover's right
full on off stump. Flicked behind square, using his wrists beautifully to place the shot to fine leg!
good length on off stump. Mistimed slog to wide long on
swatted over cover! Patel goes short, and doesn't have the pace to trouble Maxwell. Stands tall, and struck over cover with a cut
good length outside off, and cut in front of square to deep extra cover
full outside leg stump. Going down the leg side with the keeper standing up
reverse sweep again! Full on off. And he goes for the shot. Sliced in the air, but beyond the fielder at point
good length outside off. Rocks back and pulls along the ground to deep long on
full on middle, and driven to wide long on for a single. There's the fifty - his first in the IPL!
slogged powerfully through midwicket! Fullish outside off. Maxwell walks across to the off side. And drags a shot along the carpet
good length ball outside off. Opens the bat's face and plays it late to third man
good length on off, and he pulls to midwicket for one
good length just outside off. Tries to cut, misses. Through to the keeper
starts off with a four Strays first ball and Maxwell nudges it to fine leg for a four

Ashwin drops Maxwell! Axar could've had a wicket off his last ball but doesn't get the back-up from his fielder. Full on middle. Maxi goes for an expansive slog sweep. Edged towards short third man, and Ashwin dives forward, gets to the ball, but it pops out as he comes crashing onto the floor
full on off and driven towards cover
reverse sweep again. This time he can't get the timing. Mistimed
another one! That's been reversed too. Changes his stance just as Axar delivers the ball. Lands full on middle, and swept through extra cover
reversed! Full on off but he is quick to change his stance and ends up switch-hitting over third man!

full on middle. He backs away to play a big shot. Mistimed, in the air, and Iyer drops it in the deep! This was for the taking as Iyer got under it at deep midwicket, but the ball bursts through his hands
ends in fine fashion! Just nudges this length ball to third man for four!

that's in the air but just beyond Patel! Top fielding effort but just too much to do. Full outside off and Bharat tries to loft it over cover. Mistimed, in the air, but always going away from Patel at cover. He had to sprint towards the boundary to catch, and eventually just falls short
yorker length on leg stump. Dug away to long on for a single
slower ball, and wider outside off. Cut to deep point
full outside off stump, and pushed to deep extra cover
good short ball! Back of a length outside off but angling into Bharat's head. Has to defend it from near his face, and ends up gloving it towards the wicketkeeper
good length ball angling in from around the stumps. Pulled to deep square leg for one
good use of the feet! Full on off. Skips down the ground and clubbed over Axar's head for a big one! Bharat has played some excellent shots this evening.
flicked off his waist to midwicket
yorker length, on off. Dug back to the bowler
full on his toes, and he flicks it through to Smith who is the sub fielder at deep midwicket
hammered to long on. On the bounce to the fielder there. Full just outside off and Maxwell went for a big shot
full outside off and driven to wide long off for a single
full on his pads, and flicked behind square. Protection in the form of Hetmyer in the deep
short and wide again. Keeper standing up so has to move swiftly to his right. Grabbed, with Maxi offering no shot
good length ball outside off. Extra bounce off the deck. Tries to cut but misses
slaps that to long-on aerially, as Axar goes very full on off
tucks this good length ball on off to point with the open face of the bat
lofted impressively inside out! Presents the full face of the bat to this full ball outside off, and beats long-off to his left
caught at deep square leg! Axar pitches it short on middle and leg, and the ball is quicker as well as coming on with the arm. de Villiers pulls, but sends that sailing to the man placed in the deep
makes a touch of room to this full ball on middle, but finds cover
cramps him for room with this good length ball on leg, which he pushes to cover
crunched over the bowler's head! de Villiers waits for the slower ball, which is right in the slot on off. He gets his front leg out of the way, and fires that back over for four
this is again short, and a touch outside off. Pulls, but gets it off the inside half of the bat toward the on side
shortish in length, and wide of off. But he finds the man at point with his cut
slices this full ball outside off to deep point, as he plays slightly away from his body
yorker length a touch wide of off, and change of pace again. Drilled to extra cover, who is right on the edge of the circle
starts with a fullish ball on off, and with a change of pace. Pushed to cover from deep in the crease
crashes this short ball wide of off to deep point
sweeps this full ball outside leg, but gets that on the bounce to Pant, since that seemed to have take his glove. A single taken down the leg side
fuller and straighter on middle. Clipped toward square leg
launched milesss over long-on! That was in the slot for him to allow him to heave, with Ashwin going full on off. Creams that away 95 meters
shorter in length on off, and pulled between long-on and deep midwicket
skips down to this good length ball outside off, and pushes it back to the bowler
short delivery, and sharp bounce too! Pitches it on off, as the ball takes off while Bharat misses his upper cut
back of a length on off, and tapped to third man
slower ball on a short of a length on off, and de Villiers pulls that to deep square leg with a skip as the ball keeps low. His front leg was in the air while he played at that
chips on the bounce to mid-off, as he jabs at that full delivery outside off. In the air for a second, but safe
sharp length! Pitches on a back of a length just outside off, as he is beaten on the outside edge with his bat dangling out
guides that fullish ball wide of off late to third man, as the fielder runs to his right to cut that off
beaten! Slightly fullish and outside off, as de Villiers has a drive at that, but the ball goes past his outside edge
change of pace on a good length outside off, and punched back to the bowler off the inside half of the bat as he closes the bat face
short delivery on off that takes off from the surface. He looks to ramp at that, but is beaten by the extra bounce. First bouncer called
back of a length on off, and tapped to point this time
slower ball, and full and outside off. Bharat nudges that to cover, where Iyer fumbles to his right as the batters complete hurried single
dabs that good length ball on off very late to third man, while also playing close to his body
beaten on the drive! Looks to have a go at this good length delivery outside off, but the ball beats his outside edge
slower ball that is on a fullish length on off. Keeps low as well, as he clips that to dee square leg
yorker on middle and off, and pushed to mid-on with his front leg out of the way
fullish on off, and turned away behind to fine leg
just back of a length on off, as de Villiers closes the bat face and loses his bottom hand, as the ball trickles to square leg off the inside half of the bat
dabs this good length ball outside off to third man
this is fuller and straighter on middle. Pushed to long-off
swept between short fine leg and square leg! Goes down on his back knee early to this full ball on middle, and sweeps behind the wicket
skips down, and clears long-off with that loft! Just presents the full face of the bat to this fullish ball on off and gets six
much fuller on middle and off, and punched down to long-off
slower and shorter on off. Cut to point with the bounce
full and straight on middle. Driven back to the bowler
closes the bat face to this fullish ball on middle which is angling in. Clipped to deep square leg
short delivery on middle, and he swivels to pull to fine leg aerially, but the ball lands a couple of feet short easily
drives at this very full ball on off to cover, and steals a single as Iyer fumbles
nails this yorker on middle, as it is pushed to mid-on, where Rabada throws at the bowler's end, and the ball hits Bharat
goes for the yorker, but lands that just outside leg at 149kph. Bharat goes across to flick and misses, and it is called wide
opens the bat face to dab this back of a length ball outside off

ends up slicing to mid-on, who moves to his right to gobble that! Looks to launch the full delivery on middle at 146kph, as the bat turns in his hands while looking to go over the in-field. Another blow by Nortje, as Kohli seemed to have been beaten by pace, with the ball coming off the bottom of his bat
sharp short ball at 137kph! Pitches short on off, and takes off from the surface while angling in too. Bharat fends at that, but the ball just beats his glove and bat
short delivery that pitches on off, and darts away further outside off. He thinks about a poke, but misses. Wide called
leans into the drive to this full ball outside off, and drives to mid-off
fuller ball and outside off. Punched back to the bowler with the full face of the bat
hard length, and back of a length outside off. Chopped to cover off the bottom of the bat
sliced uppishly to third man after he looks to lift that full delivery outside off over cover

strikes his front pad right away as Kohli misses his flick, and Avesh is up in appeal animatedly! The ball pitched on a good length on middle, and was angling down, hitting Kohli near the knee. Looked like it was angling down leg, and also over the stumps
shortish in length on middle, and climbing on to Kohli. Clips, but misses, as the ball rolls over to the on side

ramped right to third man! It is a short delivery on middle and off, which is angling away a touch. Padikkal lifts his bat very late - almost at the last moment before the ball would have left him - and ends up fending it to Ashwin, who takes it exactly where he is standing. Golden duck for Padikkal
back of a length outside off, and dabbed to the left of the man at point
straighter ball on a good length on middle and off, as Kohli misses his clip. The ball hits his back thigh there
shorter in length outside off, and tapped to point
good length ball outside off, and he opens the bat face to tickle that to third man. Avesh scampers to his right, but Kohli still pinches two
